rationale: The message reports concrete observed behaviors from probing commands, not a plan or question. It delivers findings/results about flatten, table, and stats behavior.

evidence.text: Probed flatten/table/stats: flatten default labels header, separator '#' line; -n emits numeric labels and treats header as data.
stats default columns field,type,sum,min,max,min_length,max_length,mean,stddev; --everything adds median,mode,cardinality; null shown (NULL) in frequency.
